name: Mocchi
author: Signal Directive
description: A quiet bar icon that asks "What can I help you with?" and opens a coding-agent session with your question already sent.

barWidget.description: Ask a question and hand it to your coding agent. Uses your Omarchy default agent, or a free OpenCode model when none is set.

schema.label: Icon glyph
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown in the bar.

schema.label: Tooltip
schema.description: Text shown when you hover the icon.

schema.label: Greeting notification
schema.description: "Hi, I'm Mocchi!" toast that opens the ask box when clicked. on-restart: at every shell start (at most once per 6 hours). once: until you first ask something. off: never.
